description: Unit test class for ConfigUtil that verifies retrieval and behavior of configuration properties in the OpenMRS platform. It tests global, runtime, and system properties, as well as priority of property sources.

classes.name: ConfigUtilTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying configuration utility methods within the OpenMRS context, especially property precedence and updates.

methods.name: setupProperties
methods.description: Initializes global properties in the setup for each test, establishing the baseline properties for verification.

methods.name: shouldGetGlobalProperty
methods.description: Tests retrieval of global properties, ensuring correct values are returned for existing and non-existing properties.

methods.name: shouldGetUpdatedGlobalPropertyIfChanged
methods.description: Verifies that updating a global property reflects in subsequent retrieval.

methods.name: shouldGetUpdatedGlobalPropertyIfDeleted
methods.description: Checks that after deleting a global property, it no longer returns a value.

methods.name: shouldDetermineIfRuntimePropertyIsDefined
methods.description: Checks presence of runtime properties, both existing and undefined.

methods.name: shouldGetRuntimeProperty
methods.description: Validates retrieval of runtime properties, specifically their values matching the properties set in the context.

methods.name: shouldDetermineIfSystemPropertyIsDefined
methods.description: Verifies the detection of system properties in the Java environment.

methods.name: shouldGetSystemProperty
methods.description: Checks retrieval of system properties, ensuring the actual system property matches expected.

methods.name: shouldReturnSystemPropertyOverRuntimeProperty
methods.description: Ensures that system properties take precedence over runtime properties.

methods.name: shouldReturnSystemPropertyOverGlobalProperty
methods.description: Ensures system properties override global properties.

methods.name: shouldReturnRuntimePropertyOverGlobalProperty
methods.description: Ensures runtime properties override global properties.

methods.name: shouldReturnDefaultValueIfValueIsBlank
methods.description: Tests the behavior of property retrieval when properties are undefined, blank, or have whitespace, ensuring defaults are returned.
